title: Artifact-Gated Evaluation of a Causal FIR Module for Sequential Recommendation
description: UNPUBLISHED CANDIDATE METADATA. Code, pre-declarations, provenance manifests, and evaluation artifacts for a narrow modular study of a gradient-active left-causal depthwise FIR residual in an HSTU-style sequential recommender on Amazon Reviews 2023. The bundle includes a fail-closed evidence graph that recomputes 195 active paper cells across 19 families, causal future-perturbation tests, learned-tap/frequency-response diagnostics, comparator regeneration records, per-user sidecars, and symmetric retention of null, deviated, and VOID outcomes. An equal-parameter current-position-only placebo supports temporal access relative to that tested placebo in an outcome-known setting. The evidence does not support a broad SOTA claim, paired superiority over single-run comparators, per-channel-tap necessity, independent confirmation, or generalization. Amazon Reviews 2023 is not redistributed in this bundle; public derived assets and regeneration paths are SHA-256-pinned by RELEASE_MANIFEST.json. Replace the creator placeholder and verify legal/licensing fields before any release or DOI publication.
